titulo: Live: Houthis renew threats against Saudi airports as Riyadh attack prompts wave of condemnation
cuerpo: Yemen’s Houthi rebels warned airlines, airport staff and travellers against using Saudi airports after a strike on Riyadh killed at least 12 people and wounded more than 300. The attack drew international condemnation as Saudi Arabia threatened retaliation. Follow our liveblog for the latest developments.
